standard.summary: 按 GPU 实际 dtype 和偏置大小计费的缓存额度。1 MiB = 1048576 字节。
standard.effect: 0 关闭缓存；预算放不下的层继续原有卸载。此值不是训练总显存上限。
standard.whenToUse: 建议从 256～512 MiB 开始。Wan 双专家将此总预算平均分给两塔，第二塔未加载时其额度预留。
standard.avoidWhen: 不能把整卡空闲显存全部分给权重缓存；激活、优化器和预览仍需显存。

advanced.principle: MOSS、Krea2 等分块卸载复用同一控制器；Krea2 支持逐层缓存，传统 swap 支持冻结 Linear/Conv2d。新接线仅选择普通 FP16/BF16/FP32 冻结参数；特殊量化格式继续原卸载。Anima、Newbie 和 Native SDXL 保留已有缓存路径。
advanced.tradeoffs: 当前按显式预算静态选择，不是动态 I/O 预测。运行报告包含实际缓存量、选中层和命中次数。

standard_en.summary: Cache allowance using actual GPU dtypes, including biases. 1 MiB = 1048576 bytes.
standard_en.effect: Zero disables caching. Layers that do not fit continue through the original offloader. This is not a limit on total training VRAM.
standard_en.whenToUse: Start with 256–512 MiB. Wan dual experts split this total allowance equally; the lazy secondary tower has a reserved half.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Leave room for activations, optimizer state and previews.

advanced_en.principle: Shared block offload, Krea2 layer offload and traditional Linear/Conv2d swap use the same planner. New adapters select plain frozen FP16/BF16/FP32 parameters; specialized quantized formats keep their existing path. Anima, Newbie and native SDXL retain their existing caches.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Selection is static within the explicit budget, not dynamic I/O prediction. Runtime reports include actual bytes, selected layers and hits.
